deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the road to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at the marked pedestrian crossing to improve accessibility for wheelchair users and those with mobility aids.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.
